limitations: Known dense RGB frames are development data; checkpoint training overlap is unknown.
Duke observations repeat five small standalone SHS modules on grass, not a dense PV park; separate provenance does not prove training exclusion.
Duke references are exact author occupancy masks with holes, not physical corner labels.
External references cover only a provisional 24-module ROI, with prior prediction exposure and 1–2 px corner ambiguity.
All selected cases and failed-case references remain denominators; FP counts cover completed outputs only.
PV-Hawk uses different native tile sampling and has no centered edge recovery; this compares operational pipelines, not isolated architectures.
The single PV-Hawk confidence 0.25 ablation followed the 0.9 pilot on the same development sources; both configurations remain separate and neither is the default.
No pooled benchmark, commercial reliability, general thermal reliability or Matrice 4T validation is claimed.
SAM uses fixed CVUT V6 inventory; source-only box-mask refinement may change physical-reference association. No inventory recovery or default promotion is implied.

notes: Tight continuous-frame AABB IoU only; no physical-corner, polygon-IoU or thermal anomaly claim.
All12 author-label denominators retained including partials, duplicates, zero-label cases and failed stages.
Raw observations are deduplicated inference masks; invalid contour shape is disclosed without AABB repair/drop. Accepted quads must remain valid/convex.
Observation/FP/precision claims apply to completed outputs only; failed cases retain all reference FN.
Observed numeric class IDs lack an official class-name dictionary; no fault categories invented.
Cross-split export alias evidence and unknown checkpoint-training membership prevent an independent-training-holdout claim.
Mavic3T display JPEG transfer is not Matrice4T/radiometric/complete installed-inventory validation.
No parameter tuning, model training or hosted-default selection follows from this diagnostic.
